## Problem

What happened, and what did you expect?

## Reproduce

Steps, affected screen/API, and a minimal redacted example.

## Environment

Commit/version, OS, browser, Docker/Compose versions, and relevant service status.

## Evidence

Redacted logs or fixture-data screenshots. State whether external calls were live or mocked.
